name: jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction with a sticky email taint gate, a token trigger with hysteresis, a cache-warm idle compaction and a /jev-compact switch (agentbox ADR-2093; library from tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction, MIT).

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the container environment (.env).

enabledByDefault.title: Enabled by default
enabledByDefault.description: Starting position of the /jev-compact switch; the entrypoint projects [features.jev_compaction].enabled_by_default here.

taintTools.title: Taint tool prefixes
taintTools.description: Comma-separated tool-name prefixes; a transcript containing any such call is never sent to Jev. Default: the private email gateway and Gmail.

taintSkills.title: Taint skills
taintSkills.description: Comma-separated skill names whose Skill load taints the session. Default: email-search.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Ceiling: context percentage of the window at which turn.complete requests compaction. The effective trigger is the smaller of this and compactAtTokens.

compactAtTokens.title: Compaction tokens
compactAtTokens.description: Absolute trigger in tokens; the effective trigger is min(compactAtPercent of the window, this). Keeps a 1M-token window from waiting until 600k tokens of cache reads per turn.

rearmTokens.title: Re-arm growth
rearmTokens.description: After any compaction, the plugin re-triggers only once context has grown this many tokens past the post-compaction size, so a compaction that cannot get under the trigger does not repeat every turn. 0 means a quarter of the trigger.

cacheWarm.title: Cache-warm action
cacheWarm.description: When a session above cacheWarmFloorTokens sits idle until just before its prompt cache expires: compact (run the compaction while the cache is warm), notify (a toast suggesting /compact), or off.

cacheWarmFloorTokens.title: Cache-warm floor
cacheWarmFloorTokens.description: Context size in tokens below which the idle nudge is never armed; a small context re-prefills cheaply.

cacheTtlSeconds.title: Prompt-cache TTL (s)
cacheTtlSeconds.description: Prompt-cache lifetime the idle nudge races. 0 means detect: a session reporting subscription rate limits is 3600, one with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and no rate limits is 300, anything else 3600.

cacheTtlMarginSeconds.title: Prompt-cache margin (s)
cacheTtlMarginSeconds.description: How long before expiry the nudge fires (TTL minus this; half the TTL when the margin would exceed half of it).

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Below this estimated reduction the built-in summary runs instead.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated budget for the conversation state per request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated budget for state plus questions per request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a dropped tool result kept before its note.

baseUrl.title: System One endpoint
baseUrl.description: Full URL of the typed-decision endpoint. Unset means the vendor cloud, which is the default posture. The manifest projector sets this when [features.sovereign_system_one] is enabled (ADR-2094).

backendLocal.title: Endpoint is on this network
backendLocal.description: DECLARED, never inferred from baseUrl: a hostname is not evidence of where bytes come to rest. True permits an email-tainted session to be compacted, because nothing leaves the network; false or unset keeps the taint fence shut (ADR-2093 as amended by ADR-2094). Default false.
